description: Asks whether integer arithmetic on stored Byte 255, Integer 32767 and Long 2147483647 widens or overflows when the other operand is a separately typed 1 or 2 (CByte, CInt, CLng) or an untyped literal, the same for typed constants, and for the BIGINT (Large Number) column of Big. Each expression is its own SELECT. The result tag and Field.Type, or the failure. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
